prompt_text: Which title company in St. Louis MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company for every closing. **For a general residential closing in the St. Louis area, I’d start by comparing Arch City Title and Investors Title Company**: both describe broad local coverage and residential closing services, and Investors reports more than 20 metro-area offices. **Freedom Title** may be worth considering if flexible arrangements—such as mobile, evening, or Saturday closings—matter to you.

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm they can meet your closing date and location needs, and check recent reviews for the specific office or closer. Verify the company or agent is licensed in Missouri. You have the right to choose the title company; you don’t have to use one suggested by another party.
